sources.title: Gusto Pricing, Plans & Fees (2026) - aggregated from third-party pricing trackers, official pricing page returned 403 during this session

keyLimits.en: Base fee $49/month + $6/employee/month; single-state payroll, basic onboarding, employee self-service.
Base fee $80/month + $12/employee/month; adds multi-state payroll and time tracking.
Base fee $180/month + $22/employee/month; adds certified HR pros, priority support, payroll migration, custom reports.
Base fee $35/month + $6/contractor/month; contractor payments, 1099-NEC filing, international contractor payments in 120+ countries.

addOns.en: HR add-ons and benefits administration can raise the per-employee cost by roughly $10-30/month depending on plan.

cautions.en: Pricing is base fee plus per-employee fee, so the effective monthly cost scales directly with headcount (a 10-person team on Simple costs roughly $109/month).

Official gusto.com pricing page returned an access error during this research session; figures come from third-party pricing trackers and were not independently verified on gusto.com. Re-verify before publishing.

capabilities.en: Automated payroll runs with tax filing and compliance support in all US states.
Employee benefits administration (health insurance, retirement plans).
Contractor payments and 1099-NEC filing, including international contractors.

limitations.en: No free tier; every plan carries a base monthly fee plus a per-employee fee.
Multi-state payroll requires at least the Plus plan, not available on Simple.

reason.en: Direct competitor combining payroll, HR and IT for small and mid-size teams.
PEO-style payroll and benefits alternative targeting small businesses.
HR platform competing on the broader HR/people-ops use case.
Alternative for global/international payroll and contractor payments.

unknowns: Official pricing page (gusto.com) blocked access (HTTP 403) during this session; plan prices sourced from third-party trackers and should be re-verified directly on gusto.com.
Exact benefits/HR add-on pricing not confirmed from an official source.
